zh-CN.title: 落雪与月相重新拥有动态生命力
items: 花枝与流萤头像框正式下架，历史选择会平滑迁移到保留款式
落雪重做为多层错速雪花，大小头像都能清楚看到飘落轨迹
月相会循环展示阴晴圆缺，并保留夜空星点的细微闪烁

en.title: Snowfall and Moon Phase are alive again
items: Blossom and Firefly have been retired, with existing selections smoothly migrated to retained designs
Snowfall now uses layered flakes at varied speeds so its motion remains clear at every avatar size
Moon Phase cycles through waxing and waning while retaining subtle starlight
